verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents first-party agent tooling: the CLI exposes a broad slice of the API for read/write in sandbox or production, the AgentOS MCP writes production resources, and the Developer MCP creates sandbox test resources. It also documents Payment Links and multi-item Billing with products and a contract-to-billing skill, so an agent session could plausibly chain these together. However, no evidence explicitly shows product, price, or payment-link creation endpoints, or that these tools expose them. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating products and prices, explicit API or CLI/MCP support for creating payment links, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.
